recreation_brief:
1. Set the slide background to light gray #F2F2F2 and draw a thin dark-red (#CC0000) rectangular frame along all four slide edges.
2. Place the title 'Regression Example' top-center (~5% of slide height) in bold red #CC0000, large (~28pt) sans-serif.
3. Place a circular badge in the top-right corner: yellow #FFFF99 fill, black #000000 border, black text '29' centered inside.
4. Upper-left region (~70% of slide width): place two blue #0000CC row labels stacked at the left edge, 'x_1 =>' above 'x_2 =>'.
5. To the right of the step-4 labels, place four parenthesized 2x1 column vectors in blue #0000CC, left to right: X_1=(1;1), X_2=(2;2), X_3=(2;1), X_4=(1;2).
6. Directly beneath each step-5 vector, place red #CC0000 text: 'y_1 = 10' under X_1, 'y_2 = 15' under X_2, 'y_3 = 13' under X_3, 'y_4 = 12' under X_4.
7. To the right of X_4, place the prediction group: green italic #009900 word 'Predict', blue #0000CC vector 'X = (7;3)^T', and red #CC0000 'y = ? ? ?' below it.
8. Upper-right area (~25% of slide width): draw a box with a red #CC0000 border containing 'W = (X^T X)^{-1} X^T Y', with W in green #009900 and Y in red #CC0000; render remaining symbols in body black #000000.
9. Directly below the step-8 box, draw a box with a blue #0000CC border containing 'y = W^T X' with y and X in blue #0000CC.
10. Middle band, left ~70% width: place three blue #0000CC row labels stacked at the left edge: '1 =>', 'x_1 =>', 'x_2 =>'.
11. To the right of the step-10 labels, place four parenthesized 3x1 augmented column vectors in blue #0000CC: X_1=(1;1;1), X_2=(1;2;2), X_3=(1;2;1), X_4=(1;1;2).
12. Beneath the step-11 vectors, place red #CC0000 values 10, 15, 13, 12 aligned under X_1 through X_4.
13. At the right edge of the augmented panel, place the label 'Augmented Vectors' in magenta italic #CC00CC.
14. Lower-middle band across the full width: draw four light-background panels left to right; fill panel 1 of 4 with the red #CC0000 parenthesized column vector 'y = (10;15;13;12)'.
15. Fill panel 2 of 4 with the blue #0000CC 4x3 matrix 'X = [[1,1,1],[1,2,2],[1,2,1],[1,1,2]]' under a large bold blue X symbol.
16. Fill panel 3 of 4 with the blue #0000CC 3x4 matrix 'X^T = [[1,1,1,1],[1,2,2,1],[1,2,1,2]]'.
17. Fill panel 4 of 4 with the blue #0000CC 3x3 matrix 'X^T X = [[4,6,6],[6,10,9],[6,9,10]]'.
18. To the right of the X^T X matrix, place a beige callout box with small italic text 'Always Symmetric (and its inverse)' and a thin curved #CC6600 arrow from the box pointing at the X^T X matrix.
19. Bottom-left (~40% of slide width): place '(X^T X)^{-1}' in blue #0000CC followed by the 3x3 matrix [[4.75,-1.5,-1.5],[-1.5,1,0],[-1.5,0,1]].
20. Bottom-right (~45% of slide width): place a green #CCFFCC panel containing 'W = (X^T X)^{-1} X^T Y => W = (5;3;2)^T' with the 5 in red #CC0000, the 3 in green #009900, and the 2 in blue #0000CC.
21. Inside the green panel below the W line, place a pale-yellow #FFFFCC highlight strip containing the red #CC0000 final equation 'y = 3 x_1 + 2 x_2 + 5'.
